entries.note: Cross 2014 (PMID 24893891, epub 2014-06-03) abstract quote verbatim. Opening untested fine; AURA opened 2013-03-04, so model_first_use_year 2013 would be a slightly better proxy.

Thress 2017 (PMID 28751247, epub 2017-07-24) abstract quote verbatim; full text not open. Abstract gives no pEGFR effect size, so direction_only/medium is right. AURA results posted 2016-10-06 confirmed.

PharmR quote verbatim. Grepped PharmR/ClinPharmR/MedR and Cross 2014 full text (PMC4315625): no stated human efficacious exposure; dog tolerated 0.48x human AUC, so no margin. model_id reuses the xenograft slug although model text names rat/dog tox.
Abstract quote verbatim. Cross 2014 also shows two 20 mg AURA responders as proof of principle (comparison stated), but anecdotal, not a primary endpoint, so untested in 2014 stands.

Janne 2015 (PMID 25923549, 2015-04) quote verbatim; NCT01802632 results first posted 2016-10-06. Paired same is right for the osimertinib model. EXCLAIM-2 quote verbatim (PMID 39879577). See missing/rule questions on other members' models.
PharmR quote verbatim; 2013 proxy from AURA start date (2013-03-04) is sound.

PharmR quote verbatim; the review states hERG IC50 above clinical free drug and clean dog telemetry, then clinical QTc, so comparison_stated is right. Mobocertinib MultidisciplineR 'discrepancy ... unknown' sentence verified. Caveat: dog telemetry reached only ~0.5x human AUC.

missing: Naquotinib (ASP8273, class member): Phase 3 SOLAR (NCT02588261, first-line EGFR-activating-mutation NSCLC vs erlotinib/gefitinib, primary PFS by IRR) terminated May 2017 on IDMC futility/benefit-risk; registry results posted 2019-02-12; Astellas press release May 2017 (e.g. fiercebiotech.com/biotech/astellas-scraps-nsclc-program-after-look-at-phase-3-data). Its own xenograft model (Hirano et al. 2015, Oncotarget; DOI not verified) predicted activity. This is outside the draft's stated population (T790M or exon 20) only because the draft narrowed it.

Mobocertinib: an efficacy entry on its own exon 20 model (Gonzalvez 2021 Cancer Discov, Ba/F3/PDX) paired with EXCLAIM-2 (PMID 39879577, 2025; HR 1.04, crossed futility) is only noted in patient_trials, not scored; NCT04129502 has no posted results (completed 2026-09-22). Takeda withdrew the drug in 2023 (press release, tier 5).

Osimertinib FLAURA (first-line sensitising EGFR, NEJM 2018, 10.1056/NEJMoa1713137) is the class's main efficacy datum for the same xenograft system (PC9 Ex19del models in Cross 2014) and is absent because the population excludes first line.

Rociletinib: FDA ODAC April 2016 and complete response letter June 2016 after confirmed ORR fell to about 30% from the 59% reported earlier; hyperglycaemia in patients. Not scored; at minimum belongs in patient_trials or a note.
Olmutinib: Boehringer Ingelheim returned rights in 2016 after fatal toxic epidermal necrolysis/SJS; a safety datum for another member on its own tox package, not recorded.
rule_questions: The cell shows the BEST model's status. When a different member drug's own model (mobocertinib exon 20 Ba/F3/PDX; naquotinib xenografts) fails in its Phase 3, must that model get its own scored entries in the same cell, or only a note? The rules say 'one drug's contra beats another's same on the same model' but are silent on other models within one class.

Population when the tile gives none and members span first-line sensitising, T790M-acquired and exon 20 insertion settings: one context (EGFR-mutant) or one per biomarker? The drafter's T790M-or-exon20 choice excludes FLAURA and SOLAR.

EXCLAIM-2 / SOLAR failed against an active comparator while the drug's activity (ORR ~30%) matched the model's prediction of regression. Is failing to beat an active comparator, which no model tested, contra or untested ('conditions the model never tested')?
Rociletinib: regulatory rejection because unconfirmed responses overstated ORR, with no failed pre-specified primary endpoint. Is that an efficacy contra, a partial same, or unscored?
